title: Aberdeen Relief
description: Aberdeen has been asking after grain for weeks and Bjorn's letters keep getting shorter. The goblins own the only road anyone has tried. Take what Larton can spare through the swamp instead.

objectives.description: Load the ration packs Larton can spare (0/10)
Get the supplies through the swamp to Aberdeen
Clear what's blocking the supply route (0/8)
Put the supplies in Mayor Bjorn's hands, not a warehouse
Mark a path caravans can follow next time

notes: Threat: Aberdeen down to roughly a month of stores (invented for texture, no bible basis). Continues starving_south's relief past Larton to Aberdeen; the swamp route this quest marks is the same problem supply_line_crisis tries to solve from Aberdeen's own side, in parallel and without waiting on Larton. Read together as one regional crisis, four desks: starving_south (Larton's own shortage), retake_harbor (why Larton had nothing to spare), supply_line_crisis (Aberdeen's own gambit), aberdeen_relief (Larton's answer once it has something to send).
